summary: BicaraPro backend fully tested and passing (28/28 pytest tests). Verified auth (register/login/me + validation), MFCC audio analysis pipeline with Whisper transcription and Claude Haiku AI feedback, role-based access (siswa upload only, guru read-any), analyses history sorting, materials seeding (6 items), and all 3 teacher endpoints (students/students-history/stats). Real WAV analysis returned mfcc_mean/mfcc_std arrays of 13 values, valid intonation/clarity/overall scores in 0-100 range, non-empty ai_feedback, and duration ~3s as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — consider migrating to lifespan context manager (non-blocking).
Long-running analysis endpoint (Whisper + Claude) has no timeout guard; consider background task queue for scale.
server.py file is 621 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider modularizing (routers/audio/auth) as more features are added.
seed_data_creation: Test-only users created with @example.com emails and prefixed 'TEST'; several ephemeral analyses created for the seeded siswa. No production/seeded data mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_bicarapro_api.py runs in ~30s and covers all requested endpoints. Fixtures build a 3-second synthetic WAV in tmp dir. Note: Pydantic EmailStr rejects '.test' TLD — use @example.com for register tests. Whisper transcript on the synthetic sine-wave may be empty or gibberish; that is acceptable and the test only asserts field presence.
